_doc: Opening hours per service kind (ItemsDB shop ids plus the building services inn, healer, guild, smith/general aliases). [open, close] in game hours 0..24; close < open means it stays open past midnight; [0, 24] is always open. `default` applies to a kind not listed. `closed_lines` are what the merchant says when you try to trade out of hours (picked by hour: morning if it opens later today, evening otherwise).

morning: We open at first light. Come back then.
Shutters are down. Try again in the morning.
evening: We're closed for the day. Come back tomorrow.
Too late, friend. Come back in the morning.
Closed. The stall opens again at dawn.
